_comment: The synthetic record set the interop-cho profile serves. Every value names nobody: no real member, no real provider, no real payer, and nothing derived from any of those. The NPIs are the conventional test NPIs 1234567893 and 1679576722, whose check digits are valid so format-checking implementations accept them, and which are issued to no provider. scripts/interop/seed-cho.mjs writes this through each service's own API, so a seed passes the same validation a real write does.

auth._comment: The development identity both the seeder and the interop harness present to CHO. It lives here, in one file with two readers, because a drift between them would show up as an opaque 401 rather than as a diff. ChoAuthOptions.Validate refuses a symmetric signing key on any host that is not Development or Testing, so nothing signed with this key authenticates against anything deployed. Permissions are named rather than taken from a role: a role expands through ChoRolePermissions, and what it expands to is not this fixture's business.

backendClient._comment: The SMART Backend Services client INFERNO-BULK-SERVER-001 registers for the Bulk Data kit before it runs, through smart-auth-service's admin API with the auth identity above (settings:manage). Its keys are not here: the harness reads the public keys the kit itself publishes, so the private half never leaves the kit. providerId binds the client to the billing provider on the seeded claims, which is the Group the kit exports and the provider whose attributed patients a Patient export returns.

claims._comment: Professional. lineOfBusiness 1 = Commercial, claimType 1 = Professional: claims-service serializes its enums as numbers, and this fixture speaks its API rather than its source.

claimLines.procedureDescription: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

claims._comment: Institutional (claimType 2), inpatient by the bill-classification digit of the type of bill.

institutional._comment: facilityTypeCode is the first TWO digits of the UB-04 type of bill: facility type then bill classification. 11 = hospital inpatient. CarinNonFinancialEobProjector.IsInpatient reads the second digit, and a claim it cannot read as inpatient falls to the outpatient profile, which is the weaker of the two.

directory._comment: What the public Plan-Net Provider Directory publishes (G-36, INFERNO-PLANNET-SERVER-001): one network, one practitioner and one hospital in it, and one plan on that network with one plan document (published as a Plan-Net Endpoint). The NPIs 1888888884 and 1999999992 are synthetic, with valid check digits, and distinct from the claims NPIs so the directory seed cannot change what the CARIN BB suite reads. The directory id and payer are configured on cho-fhir-service in interop/docker-compose.interop.yml.

providers._comment: Individual. 207R00000X (Internal Medicine) is in Plan-Net's IndividualAndGroupSpecialtiesVS, so the role carries a specialty.
Organization. 282N00000X (General Acute Care Hospital) gives a HealthcareService of category hosp and an OrganizationAffiliation of role hospital.

plan._comment: Distinct from the coverage fixture's INTEROP-PLAN-1, so the directory seed cannot change claims adjudication. tenantId is overwritten by benefit-plan-service from the token; the model requires it to be present.
